title: Father, Again in Jesus Name We Meet

lines.text: Father, again in Jesus name we meet
And how in penitence beneath feet
Again to Thee our feeble voice raise
To sue for mercy and to sing Thy praise.
Oh we would bless Thee for
Thy ceaseless care.
And all Thy work from day To day declare,
Is not our life with hourly mercies crown‘d'?
Does not Thine arm ] encircles us around?
Alas! unworthy of Thy boundless love,
Too, oft with careless feel from
Thee we move.
But now, encouraged by Thy
voice we come
Returning sinners to our Father's home
Oh by that name in whom all fullness
dwells.
Oh by that blood, so freely shed for sin
Open blest mercy's gate, and take us in.
Amen.
